# UDS <a href="https://naccdata.org/data-collection/forms-documentation/uds-3"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" /></a>

## Overview

`UDS` is an R package containing data and code for the **National Alzheimer’s Coordinating Center (NACC) Uniform Data Set (UDS)** [@beekly2007national]. `UDS` is a bundle of data, analysis code examples, and html and pdf documentation. Documentation derived from this package can be found at [https://atri-biostats.github.io/UDS](https://atri-biostats.github.io/UDS)

## Installation

To install `UDS`:

* In R, run ``r paste0("install.packages(\"path/to/", pkgFilename, "\", repos = NULL, type = \"source\")")``

The script to build this R package can be found in [tools](https://github.com/atri-biostats/UDS/tree/main/tools).

The code below demonstrates how to use data in the `UDS` package and `R` [@R] to derive some basic summaries.
